title: PaymentRequest
description: Response with information related to a payment request

amount.description: Requested amount. For automatic pix it won't be returned

fees.description: Fees charged for the payment request. This includes both Pluggy's fees and any customer-specific fees. Fees are calculated based on the payment method (PIX or Boleto) and the client's pricing configuration. For sandbox accounts, fees are set to 0.

createdAt.description: Date when the payment request was created

updatedAt.description: Date when the payment request was updated

recipient.description: Recipient of the payment. Shape depends on the recipient `type`.

customer.description: Customer associated with the payment request

smartAccount.description: Smart account that receives the funds, when applicable

paymentUrl.description: URL to begin the payment intent creation flow for this payment request

pixQrCode.description: Pix QR code generated by the payment receiver

errorDetail.description: Error details when payment request fails

providerMessage.description: Error message returned by the institution

isSandbox.description: Indicates if this payment request is in sandbox mode. Default: false.

fixedAmount.description: Fixed charge amount; if filled in, it represents consent for payments of fixed amounts, not subject to change during the validity of the consent. If it's sent, minimumVariableAmount and maximumVariableAmount cannot be provided.

minimumVariableAmount.description: Minimum amount allowed per charge; if filled in, it represents consent for payments of variable amounts. If it's sent, fixedAmount cannot be provided.

maximumVariableAmount.description: Maximum amount allowed per charge; if filled in, it represents consent for payments of variable amounts. If it's sent, fixedAmount cannot be provided.

startDate.description: Represents the expected date for the first occurrence of a payment associated with the recurrence.

expiresAt.description: Expiration date for the automatic pix authorization

isRetryAccepted.description: Indicates whether the receiving customer is allowed to make payment attempts, according to the rules established in the Pix arrangement.

AutomaticPixFirstPayment.description: Definitions for the first payment. It is considered as the user's enrollment payment for the service.

date.description: Defines the target settlement date of the first payment. If not provided, it will be settled immediately. Date format must be YYYY-MM-DD (for example: 2025-06-16)

description.description: Description for the first payment. If not provided, the description will be the same as the description of the payment request

AutomaticPixInterval.description: Permitted frequency for recurring PIX payments under a consent.

AutomaticPixRetriesConfiguration.description: “Configuration for automatic retries. If provided, the scheduled payments associated with this consent will only be retried on the days specified in the array after the original payment date. This does not apply to the first payment, only for scheduled payments.

AutomaticPixSchedulerConfiguration.description: Configuration for automatic scheduling of payments. When enabled, the system will schedule payments according to the consent interval and start date.

enabled.description: When true, payments are automatically scheduled by the system.

description.description: Optional description for the scheduled payment. Overrides the payment request description when set.

valueForVariableAmount.description: Required when the consent has variable amounts (minimumVariableAmount/maximumVariableAmount). Default amount to use when scheduling the payment.

expirationDate.description: After this date, the boleto cannot be paid

baseAmount.description: Boleto original amount, without interests, penalties and discounts

penaltyAmount.description: Boleto penalty amount. If there is no penalty, it will be returned as zero

interestAmount.description: Boleto interest amount. If there is no interest, it will be returned as zero

discountAmount.description: Boleto discount amount. If there is no discounts, it will be returned as zero

totalAmount.description: Boleto final amount. It is equal to the base amount plus penalties and interests, minus discounts

updatedAt.description: Date when the lastest information of this boleto has been retrieved

BoletoPayer.description: Payer of a boleto being paid. Only identity data — this is not the payer of an issued boleto, which carries the full address block under `IssuedBoleto.payer`.

BoletoPaymentRecipient.description: Payment recipient inferred from a boleto.

taxNumber.description: Recipient CPF or CNPJ from the boleto

CUSTOM.title: Customized option
CUSTOM.description: Schedule attribute to generate payments on an explicit list of dates.

type.description: Schedule discriminator. Always `CUSTOM` for this variant.

dates.description: Explicit list of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) on which payments will be settled.

additionalInformation.description: Additional information about the custom schedule

imageUrl.description: Image of the logo hosted by Pluggy

credentials.description: Parameters required to start the connection

hasMFA.description: Does the connector require an MFA to execute?

productCoverage.description: Which sub-products the institution serves, in the Open Finance directory's own vocabulary (for example INVESTMENTS:TREASURE_TITLES, CREDIT_OPERATIONS:INVOICE_FINANCINGS). Where products says whether the connector serves investments at all, this says which ones: a connector listing INVESTMENTS may serve one of the five investment resources or all five. Absent for direct connectors, which have no Open Finance participant.

oauth.description: If 'true', the connector requires an Oauth flow to execute

oauthUrl.description: URL to perform Oauth flow if needed

resetPasswordUrl.description: URL to the financial institution to reset the password

isOpenFinance.description: Indicates if the connector uses the regulated Open Finance APIs

isSandbox.description: Indicates if the connector is a sandbox connector, meant for testing rather than a real institution

supportsPaymentInitiation.description: Indicates if the connector supports the payment initiation API

supportsScheduledPayments.description: Indicates if the connector supports scheduled payments

supportsSmartTransfers.description: Indicates if the connector supports smart transfers

supportsBoletoManagement.description: Indicates if the connector supports boleto management

supportsAutomaticPix.description: Indicates if the connector supports automatic Pix

assistiveText.description: Text to help the user when completing the input

validation.description: Regex validation for the user's input

validationMessage.description: Validation message when input doesn't match the regex

mfa.description: Credential is an MFA parameter and must be refreshed on each execution

options.description: List of possible values for the input

optional.description: Whether the credential can be left empty. Always present; defaults to false

instructions.description: Instructions to help the user obtain this credential

expiresAt.description: Expiration date of the credential value, when the institution sets one

incidents.description: Incidents currently affecting this connector, as published on https://status.pluggy.ai. Absent when the connector has none, so a healthy connector's payload is unchanged. Ordered worst-first, so the first entry is the one to show if you only show one. Note this is about the institution, not about your own connections: use it to warn a user before they pick a bank that is known to be failing right now.

details.description: Statistics about your recent connections on the connector and recent connection rate (percentage of healthy connections). This field is only present if you include the parameter healthDetails=true. This will be null if there was an error obtaining health details.

connectionRateLast6Hours.description: A number from 0 to 100: the percentage of executions that succesfully connect to the institution: status of CONNECTION_ERROR,ERROR,SITE_NOT_AVAILABLE decrease the percentage. Any other status (like SUCCESS/LOGIN_ERROR) increase the percentage. The value will be null if there were no connections

connectionsLast6Hours.description: Amount of your connections for this connector during the last 6 hours. 0 if there were no connections

ConnectorIncident.description: An incident affecting a connector right now, as published on the Pluggy status page. Only incidents active at this moment are listed: a scheduled maintenance appears once its window opens, not when it is announced, and disappears when the window closes.

id.description: Status page identifier of the incident

title.description: Short, customer-facing summary, for example 'XP Banking - Compras parceladas não sendo retornadas'

description.description: Longer explanation, when there is one

type.description: What is broken, as opposed to how badly (severity) or how far along we are (state). Use it to group the same problem across institutions, and to decide which incidents are worth showing your own users: a SCHEDULED_MAINTENANCE and a TRANSACTIONS_MISSING both read as 'degraded' otherwise. OTHER means Pluggy has not classified it, not that nothing is wrong

product.description: Which Pluggy product line the incident affects

kind.description: Whether this is an unplanned incident or a planned maintenance window

severity.description: How badly the institution is affected

state.description: Where the incident is in its lifecycle. Resolved incidents are not listed

updatedAt.description: When the incident was last updated

url.description: Permalink to the incident on the status page, with its full timeline and postmortem. Safe to show to your own users

CredentialSelectOption.description: Option for ConnectorCredential of type select

DAILY.title: Daily option
DAILY.description: Schedule attribute to generate daily payments starting from `startDate`.

type.description: Schedule discriminator. Always `DAILY` for this variant.

startDate.description: The start date of the validity of the scheduled payment authorization.

occurrences.description: Under the specified schedule frequency, how many payments will be scheduled to occur.

MONTHLY.title: Monthly option
MONTHLY.description: Schedule attribute to generate monthly payments on a specific day of the month.

type.description: Schedule discriminator. Always `MONTHLY` for this variant.

startDate.description: The start date of the validity of the scheduled payment authorization.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of the month on which each payment will occur. For example, if `10`, the first payment will occur on the next 10th day of the month after `startDate` (or the same day if it is already the 10th), and every 10th day after that.

occurrences.description: Under the specified schedule frequency, how many payments will be scheduled to occur.

PaymentCustomer.description: Response with information related to a payment customer

connector.description: Default institution to be used in the Pluggy's payment initiation flow (https://pay.pluggy.ai) by the payer.

createdAt.description: Date when the customer was created

updatedAt.description: Date when the customer was last updated

PaymentCustomerType.description:
Customer type.
- `INDIVIDUAL`: identified by `cpf`.
- `BUSINESS`: identified by `cnpj`.

PaymentInstitution.description: Response with information related to a payment institution

createdAt.description: Date when the payment institution was created

updatedAt.description: Date when the payment institution was updated

PaymentRecipient.description: Bank-account payment recipient. Returned by `/payments/recipients` endpoints and embedded inside payment requests when the request targets a registered recipient.

type.description: Recipient discriminator. Always `BANK_ACCOUNT` for this schema.

taxNumber.description: Account owner tax number. Can be CPF or CNPJ (only numbers).

paymentInstitution.description: Institution that holds the recipient's bank account.

isDefault.description: Indicates if the recipient is the default one

pixKey.description: Pix key associated with the payment recipient

createdAt.description: Date when the payment recipient was created

updatedAt.description: Date when the payment recipient was last updated

type.description: Receiver bank account type, could be: 'CHECKING_ACCOUNT', 'SAVINGS_ACCOUNT' or 'GUARANTEED_ACCOUNT'

PaymentRequestCallbackUrls.description: Redirect urls after the payment was completed or ended in error status

success.description: Url to be redirected after the payment was completed

pending.description: Url to be redirected when the payment is pending (for example, when it has status WAITING_PAYER_AUTHORIZATION

error.description: Url to be redirected after the payment ended in error status

PaymentRequestRecipient.description:
Recipient embedded inside a payment request. Polymorphic depending on the kind of payment.
- `BANK_ACCOUNT`: a registered bank-account recipient (see `PaymentRecipient`).
- `PIX_QR_CODE`: recipient derived from a PIX QR code attached to the request.
- `BOLETO`: recipient derived from a boleto attached to the request.

PaymentRequestStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a payment request.
- `CREATED`: the request was created and is waiting for a payment intent.
- `IN_PROGRESS`: a payment intent is being processed by the institution.
- `WAITING_PAYER_AUTHORIZATION`: the payer must authorize the payment at the institution.
- `AUTHORIZED`: only for Automatic PIX. The recurring consent was authorized; individual payments will be executed under it.
- `SCHEDULED`: the payment is scheduled for a future date.
- `COMPLETED`: the payment was confirmed by the institution.
- `ERROR`: the payment failed (see `errorDetail`).
- `REFUND_IN_PROGRESS`: a refund was requested and is being processed.
- `REFUNDED`: the refund was completed.
- `REFUND_ERROR`: the refund failed.
- `EXPIRED`: the request expired without being paid.
- `CANCELED`: the request was canceled.

PixQrPaymentRecipient.description: Payment recipient inferred from a PIX QR code (only the merchant name is exposed).

name.description: Merchant name decoded from the PIX QR code

SINGLE.title: One time option
SINGLE.description: Schedule attribute to generate a single payment on a specific future date.

type.description: Schedule discriminator. Always `SINGLE` for this variant.

SmartAccount.description: Pluggy Smart Account (escrow account) attached to a payment request. Receives funds and lets the client orchestrate splits and withdrawals.

agency.description: Bank agency of the smart account

type.description: Smart accounts are always checking accounts

owner.description: Legal name of the smart account holder. Only returned in detailed views.

pixKey.description: PIX key associated with the smart account

WEEKLY.title: Weekly option
WEEKLY.description: Schedule attribute to generate weekly payments on a specific day of the week.

type.description: Schedule discriminator. Always `WEEKLY` for this variant.

startDate.description: The start date of the validity of the scheduled payment authorization.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week on which each payment will occur. For instance, if set to `MONDAY`, the first payment will occur on the first Monday after `startDate` (or the same day, if it is already Monday), and every Monday after that.

occurrences.description: Under the specified schedule frequency, how many payments will be scheduled to occur.
